# Mount Brydges Heating & Cooling

> Serving Mount Brydges and the wider Middlesex County region, Mount Brydges Heating & Cooling is a home comfort contractor covering furnace repair, air conditioner service, ductless installation, heat pumps, fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning for Ontario homeowners.
